description: Read YouTube Charts or category hubs for one or more countries, with optional exact video details.

categories.description: One or more category pages. Gaming trending and Gaming live return up to 50 videos. News reads the selected news sections. Sports, Learning and Courses are editorial category feeds.
categories.title: Category hubs (mode=hubs)

charts.description: One or more YouTube charts. Trending music videos is the official replacement for the retired general Trending page. Top songs and top artists are weekly; Shorts songs is daily or weekly. Music and Shorts charts include rank movement and optional history.

enumTitles: Top songs in Shorts (daily or weekly)

charts.title: Charts (mode=charts)

countries.description: One or more markets. The 68 YouTube Charts markets are supported; 'global' is supported only for charts that publish a global ranking (top videos, top songs, top artists, Shorts songs).
countries.title: Countries

date.description: Historical chart date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty for the latest chart. Supported by Top music videos, Top songs, Top artists and Shorts songs; current-only charts ignore it.
date.title: Chart date (mode=charts)

includeVideoDetails.description: Fetch exact lifetime views, likes, upload dates and descriptions for every video. YouTube category, tags, Shorts eligibility and family-safe flags are filled when YouTube's player response is available and may be omitted on some cloud IPs. Adds one or more detail requests per video.
includeVideoDetails.title: Include exact video details

maxConcurrency.description: How many exact-detail requests may run in parallel.
maxConcurrency.title: Detail concurrency

maxItems.description: Total data rows to return across all charts, categories and countries.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxItemsPerChart.description: Rows to take from each chart/country or category/country combination. Source ceilings still apply.
maxItemsPerChart.title: Max items per chart or feed

mode.description: What to read. 'charts' uses YouTube's official music, trailer and podcast charts. 'hubs' uses YouTube's category pages such as Gaming trending, News, Sports, Learning and Courses.
mode.title: Mode

monitorName.description: Separate only-new histories by monitor name.
monitorName.title: Monitor name

newsSections.description: Which News tabs to read. 'Top stories' is the main /news page; the other sections are direct news-destination feeds. Available sections vary by country.
newsSections.title: News sections (mode=hubs, categories includes news)

onlyNew.description: Skip rows already emitted by a previous run with the same monitor name.
onlyNew.title: Only new items

period.description: Daily or weekly ranking. Weekly-only charts automatically use weekly. Current-only charts such as Trending music videos and Trending movie trailers ignore this setting.
period.title: Chart period (mode=charts)

title: YouTube Trending Feed Extractor Input
